# Page layout

> Page shell that owns the scroll container, the shared measure, and the title and actions row.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `page-layout` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/page-layout.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/page-layout.md`.

- `core`
- `scroll-area`

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/page-layout-knobs`: `pageLayoutKnobs`, types `PageLayoutKnobStyle`

## Composition

### Page shell

PageLayout owns the scroll container and the shared measure; the header and body align to the same edges.

```tsx
<PageLayout>
  <PageHeader>
    <PageTitle />
    <PageDescription />
    <PageActions />
  </PageHeader>
  <PageBody>
    page content
  </PageBody>
</PageLayout>
```

### Reading page with a rail

Pass aside to add a secondary column; it widens the measure and hides when the layout is too narrow for both columns.

```tsx
<PageLayout>
  <PageBody>
    article
    aside prop
      <TableOfContents />
  </PageBody>
</PageLayout>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { PlusIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { Card, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/card";
import { NativeSelect } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/native-select";
import {
  PageActions,
  PageBody,
  PageDescription,
  PageHeader,
  PageLayout,
  PageTitle,
  type PageWidth,
  pageWidths,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/page-layout";

const releases = [
  { name: "Inbox triage", detail: "12 unread items across 3 projects." },
  { name: "Weekly digest", detail: "Sent every Monday at 09:00 UTC." },
  { name: "Retention alerts", detail: "Two accounts crossed the churn threshold." },
];

export function PrimitivePageLayoutExample() {
  const [width, setWidth] = useState<PageWidth>("content");

  return (
    <PageLayout scroll="inset" width={width} className="h-[26rem]">
      <PageHeader variant="sticky">
        <PageTitle>Surveys</PageTitle>
        <PageDescription>Every survey in this workspace, newest first.</PageDescription>
        <PageActions>
          <NativeSelect
            aria-label="Page width"
            value={width}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const next = pageWidths.find((option) => option === event.target.value);
              if (next) setWidth(next);
            }}
          >
            {pageWidths.map((option) => (
              <option key={option} value={option}>
                {option}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
          <Button variant="solid" tone="primary" size="sm">
            <PlusIcon />
            New survey
          </Button>
        </PageActions>
      </PageHeader>
      <PageBody contentClassName="grid gap-3">
        {releases.map((release) => (
          <Card key={release.name}>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{release.name}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{release.detail}</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </PageBody>
    </PageLayout>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `page-layout`
  - `actions`
  - `aside`
  - `body`: `data-aside`
  - `content`
  - `description`
  - `header`: `data-variant` (`floating` | `flow` | `sticky`)
  - `root`: `data-scroll` (`inset` | `none` | `page`), `data-width` (`content` | `full` | `prose` | `wide`)
  - `title`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### page-layout

- `--cui-page-layout-article-size`: `40rem`
- `--cui-page-layout-aside-size`: `11.25rem`
- `--cui-page-layout-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 5)`
- `--cui-page-layout-padding-block`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 10) calc(var(--spacing) * 24)`
- `--cui-page-layout-column-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 5)`
- `--cui-page-layout-header-start-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 10)`
- `--cui-page-layout-header-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 8)`
- `--cui-page-layout-header-column-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-page-layout-title-font-size`: `var(--text-heading-1)`
- `--cui-page-layout-header-row-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-page-layout-size`: `calc(var(--cui-page-layout-article-size) + var(--cui-page-layout-padding-inline) * 2)`
- `--cui-page-layout-sticky-gap`: `0px`
- `--cui-page-layout-floating-inset`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-page-layout-background`: `var(--canvas)`
- `--cui-page-layout-sticky-header-background`: `oklch(from var(--cui-page-layout-background) l c h / 0.85)`
- `--cui-page-layout-sticky-header-backdrop-filter`: `blur(12px)`
